newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux studies Brazil Refripar deal.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux studies Brazil Refripar deal.

text.p: Electrolux said it and Brazilian white-goods company Refripar were studying the potential for a transfer of ownership of the Swedish company's two wholly-owned subsidiaries to Refripar.
It named the two companies as Electrolux Limitada and Oberdorfer S.A.
Electrolux currently owns 98 percent of the shares in Refripar and 35 percent of the share capital, and would receive additional ordinary shares in Refripar in exchange for the transfer.
Electrolux said merging the operations of the three companies would give Electrolux a larger stake in Refripar and lead to greater internal efficiency as well as a more coordinated market presence.
It said a decision on the merger was expected at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting in November.
Refripar, the second largest white goods firm in Brazil, had sales equivalent to 4.9 billion Swedish crowns in 1995. Its shares are listed on the Sao Paulo stock exchange.
